data.name: Dhikr
data.gender_notes: Dhikr is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The repeated mention or remembrance of God. The name Dhikr carries the meaning “Remembrance of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Dhikr usually hope their child will grow to embody remembrance of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A constant reminder of God's presence in our lives
data.etymology: Dhikr belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Remembrance of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhikr total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_english.name: Dhikr
in_english.meaning: Dhikr is the remembrance of God and being remembered by God
in_english.long_meaning: Dhikr is an essential part of the human body, and it plays a crucial role in maintaining good health and moral values. It is the act of remembering God and being remembered by God in various situations. Dhikr is not just about remembering God's name or attributes, but it's a way of life that involves constant remembrance and awareness of Allah's presence. It's a means of spiritual growth, self-purification, and closeness to Allah. Dhikr is highly valued in Islamic tradition and is considered a fundamental aspect of a Muslim's life.
